title: A template that NSGo apps start from, one file per template named after its slug

surface.description: The language the apps it starts are written in: Go, TSX, or both (a TSX app with Go of its own).

use.description: The command that starts a project from it, e.g. gh repo create my-app --template owner/name --clone

provisional.description: The images that stand in until the project gives its own: GitHub's card of the repository or a card drawn of it for a screenshot. The completing script sets it; the announcement's issue asks the project for them; whoever replaces one drops it from the list.
